name: testcase-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the testcase, docs-review and playwright-notion skills

plugins.name: testcase
plugins.description: QA and docs skills for ZCode, Cursor, and Antigravity: a test-case generator covering positive, negative, boundary, validation, state, permission, error, data, UI, integration, and regression scenarios; a docs-review skill auditing documentation against a spec; and a playwright-notion skill downloading Notion pages to markdown through an already-logged-in browser when no API token or Export button is available.
